Can the package I purchased this time be refunded?
Please be advised that all purchases made for this event are final and non-refundable. Once purchase is completed, no refunds will be issued under any circumstances.
What happens when my plan's quota is exhausted and how can I monitor usage?

If your plan's quota runs out, the system will automatically switch to pay-as-you-go billing using your account balance, so there is no service interruption. You can track your quota usage and account balance via real-time notifications and alerts on your Novita account dashboard.
What payment methods are supported and can I cancel my subscription anytime?

We support multiple payment methods including credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, Amex) and debit cards. You can also cancel your subscription or disable auto-renewal at any time. Your current billing cycle will continue, and the service will stop after the cycle ends.
How do I contact support and will my plan be updated over time?

If you need technical assistance, you can reach out to us at support@novita.ai. We offer a 24-hour response time for support requests. Additionally, we constantly update our plans with new state-of-the-art (SOTA) models, which are available to existing subscribers at no extra charge.
Can I purchase or upgrade a plan as an existing user?

Yes, both new and existing users can purchase a Coding Plan, as long as they haven't purchased one previously. Existing plan holders can also upgrade to higher-tier plans at any time, offering more features or a larger token quota.
Can multiple people share a plan and how is quota managed?

Yes, you can share your API Key with team members, but please note that the quota is shared. To ensure enough resources for your team, we recommend selecting the Max plans, which come with higher quotas suitable for team usage.

In most cases you only need to change the client base URL and any auth headers. Request and response shapes stay aligned with the OpenAI chat pattern you already use with vLLM, so code churn stays minimal.
